# Lancia Ypsilon workshop manual (text version)

> Official eLearn workshop manual for the Lancia Ypsilon, English. Engines: 1.2 8v, 1.2 16v, 1.4 16v, 1.3 JTD. Production periods: T.T.. Each topic is a separate HTML page with its path, applicability, and links to and from related topics.

Start with the guide, then follow links. Use the lookups to jump from a component, fuse or operation code to its pages.

## Start here
- [Guide: how the manual is organised, code systems, wire colours](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/guide.html)
- [Component index: component -> pinouts, replacement procedures, references](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/lookup/components.html)
- [Fuse and relay index: rating, junction unit and every circuit that names it](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/lookup/fuses.html)
- [Operation index: operation or test code -> topic](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/lookup/operations.html)
- [All sections](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/index.html)

## Sections
- [Technical Data](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2427645.html): technical data / specifications
- [Descriptions](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2427361.html): system description
- [Fault diagnosis](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2427465.html): fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- [Test](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2429780.html): test / check procedure
- [Procedures](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2428803.html): repair procedure (removal / refitting; the operation number is the code)
- [Electrical equipment](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/t/2427881.html): 

## Background notes
- [data-model.md](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/notes/data-model.md): wire colour codes, connector-body colours, how pinouts describe every wire, what only the diagrams add
- [rendering-rules.md](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lYpsln/en/ai/notes/rendering-rules.md): how the manual is structured: Removing/Refitting parts, Op. calls between procedures, variants
